title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Working Rules of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Working Rules of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court

Fa Fa [2014] No. 22

The Working Rules of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court, as amended at the 21st Meeting of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 4, 2014, are hereby issued.

December 8, 2014

Working Rules of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court

(Adopted at the 7th Meeting of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court on April 26, 1999; amended at the 21st Meeting of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 4, 2014)

Article 1. These Rules are formulated to standardize the work of the Compensation Committee and give full play to its functions, in accordance with the State Compensation Law of the PRC and relevant legal provisions.

Article 2. The responsibilities of the Compensation Committee are as follows:

(1) To discuss and decide the following state compensation cases:

1. Cases where a compensation claimant applies to this Court for compensation and a decision should be made by this Court;
2. Cases where a party is dissatisfied with a decision of the Compensation Committee of this Court and a reexamination and a new decision are required;
3. Cases where a party files a complaint with this Court against a decision of the Compensation Committee of a High People's Court and a direct review and decision are required;
4. Cases where the Supreme People's Procuratorate presents an opinion to this Court and a reexamination and a new decision are required;
5. Cases submitted for guidance and other major or difficult cases.

(2) To discuss draft judicial interpretations on state compensation.

(3) To summarize experience in state compensation work, and to supervise and guide the state compensation work of people's courts at all levels.

(4) To discuss and decide other major matters concerning state compensation work.

Article 3. The Compensation Committee shall hold a regular meeting once every two months. When necessary, a meeting may be convened at any time upon the proposal of the Chairperson.

A meeting of the Compensation Committee shall be held with the attendance of more than half of its members.

Article 4. Members of the Compensation Committee shall attend meetings on time. Those who are unable to attend a meeting for any reason shall promptly request leave from the Chairperson.

Article 5. A meeting of the Compensation Committee shall be presided over by the Chairperson, or by a Vice Chairperson authorized by the Chairperson.

With the consent of the meeting presider, personnel from the Office of the Compensation Committee or other relevant persons may attend the meeting as non-voting participants.

Article 6. The topics for discussion by the Compensation Committee shall be determined by the Chairperson or the Vice Chairperson.

The undertaker shall make preparations in advance and send relevant materials to each member and non-voting participants one day before the meeting; at the meeting, the undertaker shall report to the meeting as required by the meeting presider and shall be responsible for answering questions raised by the members.

When the Compensation Committee discusses a case, the undertaker shall prepare a review report before the meeting. The collegial panel and the undertaker shall be responsible for the facts of the case, and the proposed handling opinions shall state the relevant legal basis.

Article 7. The Compensation Committee shall practice democratic centralism. A case discussed by the Compensation Committee must be approved by more than half of all members to be adopted. The opinions of the minority may be reserved and recorded in the file.

Article 8. If the Compensation Committee considers a case to be major, difficult, or subject to significant divergence of opinion, it shall report to the Chairperson for submission to the Judicial Committee for discussion and decision.

The Compensation Committee shall implement the decisions of the Judicial Committee.

Article 9. Matters discussed and decided by the Compensation Committee shall be recorded in minutes of the meeting, which shall be attached to the file for future reference after being reviewed and confirmed by the meeting presider.

Article 10. The Office of the Compensation Committee shall be responsible for the secretariat work of the Compensation Committee and for executing the decisions of the Compensation Committee.

Article 11. Members of the Compensation Committee and other persons attending the meeting as non-voting participants shall abide by confidentiality provisions and shall not disclose the discussions of the Compensation Committee.

Article 12. These Rules shall come into effect on the date of adoption.
